channel.title: China AAA Games - Latest News & In-Depth Reporting
channel.description: Decoding the new era of Chinese AAA games. Breaking news, milestone reports, and in-depth analysis on Black Myth: Wukong, Zhong Kui, Phantom Blade Zero, and upcoming titles.

item.title: Golden Joystick Awards 2026: Phantom Blade Zero Nominated for Ultimate GOTY, Zhong Kui for Most Wanted
item.description: Phantom Blade Zero enters the 12-game shortlist for Ultimate Game of the Year at the 44th Golden Joystick Awards; Black Myth: Zhong Kui nominated for Most Wanted Game.

item.title: Phantom Blade Zero Surpasses 4 Million Copies in 72 Hours: Steam Peak Hits 833,000
item.description: Phantom Blade Zero sells over 4 million copies across PC and PS5 in 72 hours, generating over 1B RMB; Steam concurrent peak hits 833,000 during opening weekend.

item.title: Phantom Blade Zero Launch: 720K Steam Peak, 83% Positive
item.description: Phantom Blade Zero's first day: a 720,000 Steam peak, reviews at 83%, a 5GB day-one patch and the Nvidia driver rollback.

item.title: Phantom Blade Zero Launch Eve: Metacritic 88, Final Trailer and Preload
item.description: Phantom Blade Zero unlocks tomorrow at 10:00 Beijing time. Metacritic 88, OpenCritic 89–91, final trailer highlights, the 145GB download and 300GB preload requirement, PC specs and a Golden Joystick GOTY nomination.

item.title: Black Myth: Wukong DLC in 2026: Status, Rumors & What's Next
item.description: No Wukong DLC is in development. Game Science shelved it for Black Myth: Zhong Kui. Every confirmed fact, fake leak and official quote, updated 2026.

item.title: Black Myth: Zhong Kui's 15-Minute Gameplay, Explained
item.description: Game Science's August 2026 Zhong Kui demo explained: sword parries, talismans, ghost possession, the Great Clam Lord boss and the long road to release.

item.title: Phantom Blade Zero Release Date & Unlock Time: October 29, 2026
item.description: Phantom Blade Zero launches October 29, 2026 on PS5 and PC. Exact unlock times by region, final previews, 3 million wishlists, 8 endings and 66 Days mode.

item.title: Tides of Annihilation at Gamescom 2026: Story Trailer, Demo & Release Date
item.description: Tides of Annihilation's 'Beneath the Veil' trailer, 45-minute Gamescom 2026 demo, Gwendolyn's new voice actress and why the release date is still TBA.

item.title: Where Winds Meet 2.3 Qingzhou: New Region, Inkbound Order & DLSS 5
item.description: Where Winds Meet's October 2026 update adds Qingzhou, the Inkbound Order, Ribbon Drum combat, three world bosses and DLSS 5 — plus the 2.2 finale recap.

item.title: WUCHANG Sequel: Bai Wuchang Returns, Indolphinity's €21.5M New Chapter
item.description: Everything confirmed about the WUCHANG: Fallen Feathers sequel: Bai Wuchang's return, Indolphinity, 505 Games' €21.5M funding, the IP buyout and release status.
